create_gaussian_smearing: create a GaussianSmearing module to encode atom distances using Gaussian basis functions
create_sigmoid_smearing: create a SigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances using sigmoid basis functions
create_linear_sigmoid_smearing: create a LinearSigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances with sigmoid plus linear residual
create_silu_smearing: create a SiLUSmearing module to encode atom distances using a learnable SiLU activation layer
test_smearing_forward: test the forward pass of a smearing module with a distance tensor input
